question: Should OpenClaw accept this bounded durable `gateway_restart_audit` SQLite table as the restart forensics and privacy contract?
rationale: The remaining choice is not a mechanical code fix: it decides what restart metadata may be persisted locally, how much context is acceptable, and whether the 512-row retention/redaction policy is sufficient for operators.

options.title: Accept bounded SQLite audit
options.body: After conflict resolution, approve the 512-row redacted shared-SQLite restart audit table as the local restart-forensics contract.

options.title: Narrow durable metadata
options.body: Require fewer fields or a stricter read/export contract before accepting durable restart audit rows.

options.title: Pause durable audit
options.body: Park or close this PR if restart attribution should remain in existing logs/diagnostics instead of a new state table.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded SQLite audit
recommendation.body: After conflict resolution, approve the 512-row redacted shared-SQLite restart audit table as the local restart-forensics contract.
